items.title: Albert French Interview
items.q: He learned from old man Perkins. Old man Perkins was his teacher.

ctx.x: Sorry. Can you tell us some more about your father, where he learned and what kind of a band he
played in? Well, my father, most of the band he played, he played with the brass band. And he learned from old man Perkins. Old man Perkins was his teacher.
